PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Handling Hazardous Substances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.

5. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Oblique Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Oblique Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Oblique Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Oblique Projection.

6. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.

7. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

8. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

10. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

11. When learning Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood.

12. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Driving Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Driving Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Exploration and Career Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Oblique Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
